title: [PR] fix(ui-components): stack mj-dialog above mj-slide-panel via z tokens

A dialog opened from a slide panel rendered *under* it: `mj-dialog`'s backdrop shipped at `z-index: 1000` and `.sp-panel` at 1001. The User-360 / asset-preview pattern in LXP hit this on day one and bridged it with a `z-index: 1010` override keyed to MJ class names (LXP upstream ask P13)
